current: qip-strategy's compiler is exactly the 'refuse what cannot be bounded' compiler this row describes, for compiled strategies. It performs four checks. Declared inputs: every feature a strategy names must be declared in the FeatureCatalogue, or it is refused. Stated worst case: CompiledStrategy::cost() is the worst-case reachable node count, and above CompilerLimits::max_nodes (512 by default) the strategy is refused rather than trimmed; nesting beyond max_depth is refused too. No recursion: ir::Expr is a finite tree with no loop or call node, and Program::from_nodes refuses a node that reads itself or points forward. Runtime re-check: StrategyRuntime enforces a budget that does not grow with the program it is given, and Cell::deploy refuses a strategy whose cost exceeds the cell's strategy_budget. Evaluation cost does not depend on the market, and the acceptance performance suite measures it over firing and quiet vectors. What is missing: fabric-compiled predicates as the source; a per-artefact measurement over adversarial inputs asserted against that artefact's own declared bound; and a recursive predicate refused at compilation. Here recursion is unrepresentable in the IR rather than refused, and only the program-level check refuses a self-reading node. The assessor's rg included 'worst_case' over backend/crates/edge and reported no matches. It matches qip-strategy/tests/strategy.rs:255.

current: No symbolic theory store and no theory-revision-task type exist. Two production paths already turn a contradiction of held theory into an explicit, journaled record naming the element and its evidence, without silently modifying it. (1) Declared risk rules: qip-kernel/src/rule_review.rs, via Platform::review_rules (platform.rs:17460, called from stage_learn at :13988). When the twin's scores show a rule vetoing mostly profitable paths, it journals a RecalibrationProposal under Topic::RiskRuleRecalibration. The proposal names the rule, its current and proposed bounds and the scored orders (RegretEvidence), and the running limit set never applies it: only a two-signature LimitSet::rebound artefact can move the bound. That is a revision task in all but name, for one theory class, in one direction. (2) Causal structure (ADR 0087): when an edge's own precedence test fails, record_causal_condition_failure marks it KnownToFail. After RETIREMENT_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES (3) in one regime the edge is retired from inference but kept in the graph under EdgeStanding::Retired with the regime, instant and run, and journaled as ChangeKind::CausalEdgeRetired. That is explicit, but it is an automatic retirement rather than a task for review. qip-kernel/src/causal_review.rs::audit_controls reports precedence edges that fail a controlled re-test as a finding and writes nothing. falsification.rs and references.rs remain the adjacent claim and citation mechanisms the assessor named.
gap: There is no theory-revision-task type. Rule contradiction is covered only for risk limits, and only in the too-tight direction: a rule contradicted by evidence that it is too loose, or by another rule, raises nothing.
